description.text:
McGill-NLP/AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1 fine-tuned with full fine-tuning (DeepSpeed ZeRO-3) on israel/AfriGuard-inst: each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt, and the target is <safety>…</safety> <category>…</category> <response>…</response>.

This is a rerun of the AfriGuard-inst config afriguard.yaml from the AfriGuard-model (LlamaFactory) repo, with only the output paths changed (examples/train_full/afriguard_inst_afriqueqwen3.5-4b-50langs-instruct_full_sft.yaml), made as the matched baseline for adzcai/AfriGuardPlain-AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1, the same setup trained on adzcai/AfriGuard-plain (no instruction, no tags). 1 epoch, 1 GPU, chat template of the base model, loss on the response only.

quotes: each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt
<safety>safe|unsafe</safety> <category>top_category (always, for safe and unsafe prompts)</category> <response>final reply</response>

serving.notes: The card describes text training examples and does not show a usage example. config.json is Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration with a vision_config (depth 24, hidden 1024) and tie_word_embeddings true. Hub safetensors total is 4,539,265,536 BF16 parameters, 333,514,240 above the parent checkpoint's 4,205,751,296. processor_config.json includes an image processor and a video processor. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; chat_template.jinja is present and counts images and videos. generation_config.json sets eos and pad token ids and use_cache, and does not set temperature, top_p, top_k, or max_new_tokens. The card prose says 1 GPU; the hyperparameter block says distributed_type: multi-GPU. trainer_state.json records train_batch_size 1, max_steps 23153, epoch 1.0. 46306 train rows divided by total batch 2 equals 23153 steps.
